meta.title: WoW Forever rare tameable beasts
meta.method_note: Pet sites could not be fetched directly (network allowlist); data comes from web-search summaries of the cited pages. Petopia Forever pages were indexed but their full tables were not readable, so many coordinates come from wowhandbook, Conquest Capped and similar guides. NPC IDs are null unless a source URL carried them. Re-checked live on 2026-11-26: npc ids, levels and spawn points now come from the Out of Games and Warcraft DB game-data pages (see verified).
meta.confidence_rule: high = 2+ sources agree on zone and spawn; medium = single source or no coordinates; low = conflicting zone/family/level/spawn or classic-only data.
known_gaps: Azzere the Skyblade, Washte Pawne, Mezzir the Howler, Bloodroar the Stalker, Deatheye, Bjarn, King Bangalash, Bhag'thera, Ghost Howl were named by some pages but are not covered here (not re-checked)
Petopia's 'collector' (unique look) flags were not readable per pet (petopia.com reset the connection)
Spawn points are Out of Games map sightings/game-data spawns clustered to at most 6 per pet; rares with one recorded point may still have more spawn spots in the live game
meta.family_notes: Forever adds a Fox family (Trickster's Dance: +50% dodge and 30% faster attacks for 12 s) and renames Owl to Bird of Prey. You cannot tame a beast above your level.

riverglades.note: Forever-only zone. The in-game name has no leading 'The'. uiMapID 2548 comes from Warcraft DB's map pin for Ghostmaw and matches tools/../ZoneData.lua; the WoW UI source in the scratchpad (1.60.1.71139) holds no zone names, so it could not confirm it.

verified.checked_live: All 57 beasts looked up by name in Warcraft DB Forever (npc id, creature family, classification) and opened on Out of Games (npc id, level, rank, side, map spawn points from game data 1.60.1).
verified.not_reachable: Wowhead Forever (HTTP 403), petopia.com (connection reset), warcraft.wiki.gg (bot challenge).
verified.changed: npc_id filled for 55 pets (2 already had one; both confirmed); spawns filled for every pet (previous lists kept in alt where they differed); zone 'The Riverglades' renamed 'Riverglades'; several levels/ranks aligned with the game data.
verified.uncertain: Ranks where the two databases differ (Humar the Pridelord, Takk the Leaper, Old Rusthowl, Slydris: Warcraft DB says rare elite, Out of Games rare); single-point rares may have more spawns; Shalla'kal's tameability; Echeyakee and Ta'shkal are summoned, not free spawns.

pets.name: Ta'shkal
pets.notes: Secret green-and-orange cat with 1.0 s attack speed. Not in the open world: loot a grey Corrupted Cat Figurine from the fel pools of Felblood Scar (southern Hyjal), then use the Lonely Lantern on the hill above Mourning's Rest while carrying it. The figurine can be consumed without a spawn, so bring spares. Coordinates are the lantern. Spawns: 2 points recorded on the Out of Games map, clustered. Rank normal in the game data (was listed as rare). Title 'Escaped Experiment', no Rare flag (summoned).
